cards.headline: The tape: a mixed, rotational tape, 55% of energy names green

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Shale & E&P lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +6.10%; weakest is Shale & E&P at -1.48%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.body: Leaders: ARRY +19.87%, BE +9.16%, ENPH +8.16%, TLN +7.27%, ETN +6.98%. Laggards: FANG -2.92%, MPLX -2.17%, UUUU -2.10%, APA -1.91%.
